design.shape: one stable facade (Proxy over the DshAdapter surface) whose EVERY property access resolves the service; nothing is resolved at apply
design.cache_rule: only a SUCCESSFUL STRICT read (`ctx.get('mpdDsh')`, i.e. an ACTIVE provider) is cached; a miss is retried on every later use, so the mounted adapter is picked up the moment its fiber activates

miss_modes.registered_but_not_active: strict read undefined + non-strict read (`ctx.get('mpdDsh', false)`) hits -> warned ONCE per row as 'ADAPTER NOT YET ACTIVE … provider … is not ACTIVE yet', served by a temporary adapter, NO row-order hint
miss_modes.absent: strict AND non-strict reads miss -> the row-order hint is the provable fix; warned ONCE per row as 'ADAPTER FALLBACK (adapterIdentity=fallback:createDshAdapter) … fix the ROW ORDER'

design.identity: dshAdapterIdentity(ctx) reports mounted:mpdDsh / pending:provider-not-active / fallback:createDshAdapter, READ AT SURFACE TIME (boot line + the adapterIdentity field of the mpdExtensions / mpdRoles services), never cached at apply
design.bound_retry_choice: per-use re-probe IS the bounded retry (every access, including tool handlers a row registered during apply, retries); no async wait is needed for a SYNCHRONOUS seam call

code_path_justification_measured_on_vend.why_needed: the register's honest bound: six consecutive clean boots on the correctly ordered tree never opened the window (t24, 6/6 adapterIdentity=mounted:mpdDsh, zero fallback lines) — so this change is justified by the code path, not by an observed failure
code_path_justification_measured_on_vend.probe_1_sibling_apply: root.plugin(provider) then root.plugin(consumer) without awaiting: during the CONSUMER's apply the provider fiber state is 1 (not ACTIVE), consumer `ctx.get('mpdDsh')` (strict) = undefined, `ctx.get('mpdDsh', false)` = the value, provider state after the consumer settles = 2 (ACTIVE) and the strict read then succeeds
code_path_justification_measured_on_vend.probe_2_activation: await <fiber> moves state 1 -> 2 and flips the strict read from undefined to the value
